question: A personal foul in basketball primarily involves:

options.text: Illegal physical contact during active play

solution:
The correct answer is __**Illegal physical contact during active play**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• A **personal foul** in basketball primarily involves **illegal physical contact** between players during active gameplay. Examples include pushing, holding, tripping, or physically impeding an opponent's movement. 
• The purpose of the personal foul rule is to ensure that the game remains **safe, fair, and competitive**, avoiding unnecessary injuries or unfair advantages. 
• Personal fouls can occur during actions like **blocking** (illegally impeding the progress of an opponent) or **charging** (running into a stationary defender).
